audience: Facility staff who record goods receipt (MRN) and recycling (Form 6)

steps.title: Step 1 — Sign in as Factory Manager
steps.howTo:
1. Open the portal URL.
2. Enter the factory account email issued by Urbeno (for example the Bengaluru or Kolar facility login).
3. Enter your password and click Sign In.
4. Accept Terms and Privacy on first login if prompted.
steps.tips: Factory accounts are privileged. Set up two-factor authentication on Profile when Urbeno asks you to. Do not use a client login for factory work.

steps.title: Step 2 — Factory dashboard
steps.howTo:
1. Confirm the heading shows a Factory / facility dashboard (e.g. URB-BLR).
2. Review tiles for open work, capacity used, and payments if shown.
3. Use navigation: Dashboard, Requests, Capacity, Reports.
4. Confirm Masters, Audit, Compliance, Recycling Heroes, and Sustainability are NOT in the menu.
steps.tips: If you can open Compliance or Masters, stop and report a Blocker — those are admin-only.

steps.title: Step 3 — Requests ready for factory work
steps.howTo:
1. Open Requests.
2. Find invoiced requests that need MRN (Stage 5) or Form 6 (Stage 6).
3. Confirm there is no + New Request for factory users — clients and admins raise requests.
4. Open an invoiced request to continue to goods receipt.
steps.tips: Seeded training data may include sample REQ numbers. Prefer a live invoiced request for practice.

steps.title: Step 4 — Open request detail for MRN / Form 6
steps.howTo:
1. On request detail, locate the invoice panel.
2. When Stage is 5 (invoiced) and no MRN exists, look for Create MRN.
3. After MRN exists, look for Process & Issue Form 6.
4. Confirm you do NOT see Acknowledge, Raise Invoice, or Upload Certificate (admin actions).
5. Confirm clients will not see MRN numbers even though you create them here.
steps.tips: One MRN per invoice. Form 6 category split must equal billing weight exactly.

steps.title: Step 6 — Monitor factory capacity
steps.howTo:
1. Open Capacity.
2. Review category utilisation for your facility.
3. Watch for warnings near 80% and blocks at 100% authorised TPA.
4. If Form 6 would exceed capacity, you need an approved override reason — do not bypass silently.
steps.tips: Capacity protects regulatory limits. Escalate to Urbeno admin before forcing an override.

steps.title: Step 7 — Factory reports
steps.howTo:
1. Open Reports.
2. Run MRN Register, Form 6 Log, Device Serials, Certificate Log, or Capacity Utilisation as available to your role.
3. Export CSV/PDF when needed for audits.
4. Confirm period filters refresh figures correctly.
steps.tips: Factory reports may include MRN data that clients must never receive. Handle exports carefully.

steps.title: Step 8 — Profile, facilities, and two-factor
steps.howTo:
1. Open Profile.
2. Confirm Role is Factory Manager and Facilities lists your plant (e.g. URB-BLR).
3. Set up Two-factor authentication when required for privileged roles.
4. Change password using the policy (10+ chars, upper, lower, digit) if Urbeno asks.
steps.tips: Factory MFA is recommended/required by policy for privileged roles. Keep your authenticator device safe.

steps.title: Step 9 — Sign out
steps.howTo:
1. Click Logout when finished.
2. Confirm the Sign In screen appears.
3. Never leave a signed-in factory session on a shared kiosk.
steps.tips: Factory sessions can create legal documents (MRN / Form 6). Always sign out.
